name: Prickly pear cactus
desc: Cactus whose pads, flowers and fruit feed tortoises and finches. On some islands it grows tree-like, which keeps its pads out of reach of grazers.
about: Opuntia, commonly called the prickly pear cactus, is a genus of flowering plants in the cactus family Cactaceae, many known for their flavorful fruit and showy flowers.
